d: The Philippines is hosting the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit from November 15 to 17 in Manila. With Prime Minister Narendra Modi set to attend the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit and the 21st East Asia Summit in Manila, India will look to reinforce its strategic partnership with Southeast Asia. Amid growing geopolitical uncertainty, Southeast Asia is emerging as one of the world's most strategically important regions. The US-Iran conflict, China's growing assertiveness, and intensifying rivalry between Washington and Beijing have put the 11-member grouping under pressure.…
